observation_examples: cluster state observed: pod not ready
resource status observed: deployment replicas below desired
node event observed: eviction or scheduling pressure
intention_examples: autoscaler intends replica expansion under load
commitment_examples: controller commits to reconciliation action sequence
scheduler commits to placement decision under constraints
admission policy commits acceptance/rejection with traceable authorization

conflict_shape.example: concurrent controllers propose incompatible updates to same workload
conflict_shape.expected_behavior: competing intentions remain explicit; policy layer resolves precedence without hiding conflict

replay_shape.example: reconstruct control-plane decision trail for an outage window
replay_shape.expected_behavior: deterministic replay of observations, intents, and commitments to explain final resource state

notes: Kubernetes reconciliation maps cleanly when reconciliation/policy stays above TRS and TRS provides immutable coordination trace.
